article.provisionalTitle: Review developer artifacts before clearing space on a Mac
article.primaryIntent: Decide which rebuildable developer artifacts to review, and what to do when space consumption returns
article.distinctMechanism: Separate caches, generated dependencies and original projects; evaluate rebuild/download cost, inspect the cleanup destination and retain a recovery/verification checklist. MacSweep's developer module is the concrete documented entry point, not a template substitution.
outline: Build a review inventory without treating size as deletion permission
Distinguish DerivedData and dependency artifacts from original work
Compare documented module limits and approval unknowns
Choose a local module-oriented scan or an ongoing investigation workflow
Review results without equating Trash size to free-space change
article.interactionPass: Handoff a local decision checklist: known owner? reproducible inputs? backup? rebuild cost? exact target/method reviewed? No scan, deletion, fabricated calculation or forced code demo.
article.visualPlan: Breathing Room Space example preview after lead; cleared and visually verified official MacSweep UI later. Currently blocked.
article.conditions: Do not publish exact MacSweep instructions, 30-day recovery promises or measured benefits without corresponding evidence. Workflow advice requires primary Apple/tool documentation at drafting stage; none newly asserted as tested here.

comparison.provisionalTitle: Breathing Room vs MacSweep: cleanup scope and review trade-offs
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between a documented local cleanup utility and a preview with broader source-implemented investigation workflows
sections: Claim-linked platform, module, local/hosted and pricing matrix
Link to workflow article and comparison hub
comparison.length: Concise; no padded word count, invented FAQ or duplicate alternatives route

macsweepAdvantages: Documented Mac-only module approach and vendor-promised offline/no-registration scan fit readers who prefer a local utility (M04, M07); not independently audited.
Advertised macOS 12 support reaches an older OS baseline than Breathing Room's macOS 13+ preview (M02, BR01).
Public release claims notarization/stapling where Breathing Room discloses a non-notarized preview (M10, BR01); not independent binary validation.
macsweepTradeoffs: Free advertised cleanup is capped at 500 MB/month and only three modules (M08).
Effective annual promotion unresolved; no price-superiority argument (M09).
Exact controls, app licence, runtime dependencies and process/growth dimensions remain unknown, not absent (M11, M12).
breathingRoomAdvantages: For readers investigating repeated growth or helper activity, grouped process/activity and reviewable developer-cleanup source implementations are relevant (BR02); release parity and native behavior remain unverified.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview, Python prerequisite, macOS 13+ and non-notarized disclosure may rule it out (BR01).
Hosted AI needs internet/authentication and sends relevant context; optional AI Care is recurring paid service, not offline AI (BR03).
